title: The release queue
hook: A toy service finishes five releases per round. What if admissions match that rate?

knows: basic arithmetic and the meaning of a percentage
doesNotKnow: Distinguish admitted work from completed work and calculate the resulting queue stock.

misconception: Starting more jobs necessarily increases the number the service can finish each round.
objective: Distinguish admitted work from completed work and calculate the resulting queue stock.

Deterministic fixed rates only; latency, randomness and real deployment reliability are not estimated.

claims.text: A toy queue starts with 2 jobs, admits 6 and finishes 4 per round for three rounds. Waiting jobs? Net inflow is two jobs per round; 2 + 3 × 2 = 8 waiting jobs.
claims.source: Original transfer toy, feedback, inputs [2, 6, 4, 3], output 8; independent Python recomputation.
